_comments: PriceOverrideReason is required when PriceOverridden is set: the order line's own validation
refuses a flagged line with no reason (bc-aidp-next-golive#253). The column itself stays
nullable — lines converted from the previous system carry overridden prices with no reason
and must stay loadable. AutoUpdateDescription is off so CodeGen does not restore the column's
extended-property text, which still calls the note optional.

fields.Description: Why this line's price was moved off the default. Required when PriceOverridden is set: a save that flags the price as overridden and gives no reason is refused. NULL when the price is the default.
